title: Introducing IEX Signal v7
raw_text:
Introducing IEX Signal v7
Category: Trading; Alert 2026-014
Overview Effective August 17, 2026, IEX Exchange plans to introduce an enhanced Crumbling Quote Indicator ("CQI"). This enhanced CQI (“Signal v7”) will replace the current CQI ("Signal v6"). Like Signal v6, Signal v7 makes quote instability determinations for all Discretionary Limit (“D-Limit”) orders and Corporate Discretionary Peg (“C-Peg”) orders. Signal v7 also makes quote instability determinations for Discretionary Peg (“D-Peg”) and Primary Peg (“P-Peg”), unless the User has instructed IEX to apply the Quote Imbalance Indicator (“QII” or “Ultra-Passive Signal”) instead. There will be no configuration changes required by Users to utilize the Signal v7 enhancement for D-Limit, D-Peg, P-Peg, or C-Peg orders. Deployment Schedule Date Symbols Monday, August 17 'A' - 'F' Friday, August 21 All symbols ’A’ - ’Z’ Details The CQI is designed to predict crumbling quotes on either side of the market for all symbols. Signal v7’s nine quote instability rules, inputs, reference prices, and other values continue to operate in the same manner as Signal v6. Signal v6 utilizes real time relative quoting activity from eleven exchanges (the “Signal Exchanges”) as reference data for the quote instability rules. Signal v7 includes IEX's own Protected Quotation, in addition to the Protected Quotations of the Signal Exchanges, in the reference price calculations used to determine the Signal Best Bid and Signal Best Offer. Listing Alert MIAX Sapphire August 17, 2026 | 05:32 PM MIAX Exchange Group - Options Markets - Listing of Addtional Weekly Expirations for Qualified Securities The MIAX Options Exchanges have filed with the SEC to amend the Short Term Option Series Program as it pertains to Qualifying Securities. Specifically, the Short Term Option Series Program will be amended to include: (1) adding up to two Tuesday and Thursday expirations for options on ETF Shares that meet the existing "Qualifying Securities" criteria, and (2) adding up to two Monday and Wednesday expirations for options on ETF Shares that meet a new, lower-threshold set of criteria. ETFs meeting the existing criteria of an Assets under Management ("AUM") greater than $50 billion, monthly options volume greater than 10 million contracts, a position limit of at least 250,000 contracts, and participation in the Penny Interval Program, are rebranded as "Tier 1 Qualifying Securities" and become eligible for Tuesday/Thursday weeklies in addition to their current Monday/Wednesday expirations. In addtion, a new "Tier 2 Qualifying Securities" tier is created for ETFs with AUM greater than $25 billion and monthly options volume greater than 5 million contracts (retaining the 250,000-contract position limit and Penny Interval Program participation requirements), which will be eligible for up to two Monday and Wednesday expirations. The new series follow the existing Short Term Option Series Program process of same strike-price intervals, P.M.-settled, and skips any week where the expiration would coincide with a standard, monthly, or quarterly expiration. A Qualifying Security expiration would not be listed on a day when there will be an earnings announcement that takes place after market close. On August 18, 2026, the MIAX Options Exchanges will begin listing Qualifying Securities with the following expiration dates: Category Securities Expiration Dates Tier 1 Qualifying Securities GLD, SMH,XLF August 20, 25, and 27, 2026 Tier 2 Qualifying Securities DRAM, SOXL, IBIT, XLE, TQQQ, EEM August 19, 24, 26, and 31, 2026 Please contact MIAX Listings with any questions at Listings@miaxglobal.com or (609) 897-7308.
